title: Table 2.1 Minimum side setbacks
notes: Minimum side setback in metres (A2.4.1); Nil = 0. Extract '4m 4m 4m Nil Nil' read as R80-LR1 | R100-R160 | MR1 | MR2 | HR1-HR3 per C4P2-037 to C4P2-044. The Volume 2 'average side setback where building length exceeds 16m' row is deleted (C4P2-045). Note 5: boundary setbacks are also determined by 2.7 separation, 3.5 visual privacy and the NCC. Rows also match the current names (R-AC4 = LR1, R-AC3 = MR2, R-AC1 = HR1, R-AC0 = R-PA; register C4P2-017). R-AC2 has no column and no row. The generic LR, MR and HR bands have no row (MR and HR each span columns with different values), so a site coded only LR, MR or HR is NOT_APPLICABLE until its code is known.
